{{Quote|Torrent, Cascade, and Waterfall companies are depending on us to sweep the streets for 'em. And we are not going to let them down. Agreed?''"<br />"''Agreed!|Anakin Skywalker and the clone pilots of Gold Squadron|<ref name="CWG:S" />}}
'''Waterfall Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|company]] of<ref name="CWG:S" /> 144 [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], along with support personnel, that served within one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]],<ref name="Composition" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWG:S" /> Subdivided into four [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]],<ref name="Composition" /> the company was led by<ref name="CWG:S" /> [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]]<ref name="High Jedi General" /> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] during a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] against [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatist forces]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] in<ref name="CWG:S" /> [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', including the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] on [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], are established to have taken place eleven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of {{Film|I}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. As such, the battle on Kothlis must have taken place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref>

The company was assigned to fight on the planet's surface alongside the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] of [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] and [[Cascade Company]]. Prior to the battle, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] made a speech to the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] of [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]], in which he mentioned Waterfall Company alongside the other companies. To raise the morale of the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], Skywalker reminded them that all three companies were depending on them to clear a path to the planet's surface, and that they were not going to disappoint them.<ref name="CWG:S" />

==Behind the scenes==
Waterfall Company was mentioned in ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', a [[2010]] novel written by [[Karen Miller]]<ref name="CWG:S" /> as a tie-in to the [[2008]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series.<ref name="BTS">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20080625.html|text=Del Rey & LucasBooks announce ''Clone Wars'' Novels}}</ref>
